components.purpose: Title and one-line intro at the top of the page, with no image or buttons. Header's guidance covers a plain heading with optional subheading and description, and it rules out Hero and BackgroundHero because the request has no image.
The plans as side-by-side cards, each with name, monthly price, highlights and a CTA button.
The full comparison grid below the cards, with each feature as a row and a column per plan. PricingTable is the right choice over ComparisonTable, which is for competitor comparisons.
The billing FAQs at the bottom of the page.
